The '''Seaside Windfarms''' was an area of the [[Apalis Coast]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was inhabited by such creatures as [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], [[bolraida]]s and [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|flutterplumes]].
